reader.requirement: At 85 the words LENGTH, RANDOM and SUM must be accepted both as function-names (FUNCTION LENGTH/RANDOM/SUM) and as reserved words in their keyword contexts (ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM, the report SUM clause), classified by context in the same program, and must be refused as any user-defined word (data-name at any level, condition-name, index-name, paragraph-name, file-name, program-name, mnemonic-name) or system-name (computer-name) regardless of context.

edition-consulted.switches: whether the word is reserved at the edition; the LENGTH, RANDOM and SUM rows (ReservedWords.Table.cs) are reserved at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023 alike
COBOL0901 severity and message by edition year (strict error at 85 as at 2023)
a function-name written without FUNCTION: the REPOSITORY FUNCTION entry (repository-function-2002) does not exist at 85, so SUM (1 2) is refused (COBOL1543) with the 85 remedy
numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric function (LENGTH, RANDOM, SUM) is admitted only inside an arithmetic expression; not part of this rule's word classes

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the three words are reserved and usable as function-names at every edition; only the keyword-omitted function spelling (2002 REPOSITORY) differs, and it is outside this rule

reader.notes: LENGTH reaches a user-word slot through reservedGatedWord and is refused by the 0901 funnel; SUM and RANDOM are refused by the parser in slots where they are keyword tokens (COBOL5506) and by the funnel elsewhere (COBOL0901), so every user-defined-word and system-name class probed is refused at 85. The reserved rows for the three words are the same at all four editions.

refuter.evidence: §1985:IV.4.2.2.1.1 lists text-name and library-name among the types of user-defined words (items 9 and 19), and SR2b forbids LENGTH, RANDOM and SUM as any user-defined word 'regardless of context'. At --std 85 k_text.cob (WORKING-STORAGE: COPY LENGTH. with LENGTH.cpy beside it) compiles and runs, printing TXT (runs/k_text-001, EXIT 0); k_textr.cob COPY RANDOM. likewise prints TXT; sibling k_texta.cob COPY ADD. (any reserved word as a text-name) also compiles and runs. k_lib.cob COPY KTLIB OF SUM. is refused only as 'CBL3620 COPY copybook KTLIB OF SUM not found' (a search failure, not the reserved-word refusal: misleads-diagnosis). The reader's other slots hold: section-name SUM (COBOL0901), alphabet-name LENGTH (COBOL0901), class-name RANDOM (COBOL5506), symbolic-character SUM (COBOL5506), cd-name LENGTH (COBOL0901), report-name SUM (COBOL5506), language-name LENGTH in ENTER (COBOL0901), implementor-name RANDOM (COBOL1970); k_cdok.cob CD ... TEXT LENGTH IS KC-LEN beside FUNCTION LENGTH(W) prints 05 (context classification works). At --std 2023 COPY LENGTH also compiles and runs (TXT). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 SR2  (4.2.2.1 COBOL Words)  the text is in SR2' (quote 'may not be used as a system-name or as a user-defined word regardless of context'); 'OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.1.1  (4.2.2.1.1 User-Defined Words)  the text is in the clause'.
